name: LAENeRF
aliases: Local Appearance Editing for Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A unified framework for photorealistic and non-photorealistic appearance editing of pre-trained NeRFs. It enables local recoloring and stylization of arbitrary regions while minimizing background artifacts and maintaining interactivity.
summary: LAENeRF is a framework for locally editing pre-trained NeRFs using a 3D edit grid and palette-based module to minimize background artifacts and ensure smooth transitions.
